chunks.title: ICMR Dengue & Viral Fever Clinical Protocol
chunks.condition: Dengue Fever, Viral Pyrexia, Thrombocytopenia
chunks.scheme_ref: Aarogyasri Acute Inpatient Care
chunks.content: ICMR Guidelines for Dengue Management: 1. Avoid all NSAIDs, Aspirin, Ibuprofen, and Mefenamic Acid due to bleeding and platelet dysfunction risks. 2. Prescribe Paracetamol (650mg SOS, max 3g/24h) for fever control. 3. Monitor daily Complete Blood Picture (CBP) and platelet count. Platelets below 50,000/mcL or hematocrit rise >20% requires hospitalization. 4. Maintain oral rehydration therapy (ORS, tender coconut water, soup). 5. Warning signs: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy. Covered under Aarogyasri for free hospital admission.

chunks.content: Aarogyasri Health Scheme provides 100% cashless treatment up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year across 1,672+ empaneled government and private network hospitals. Covers 3,257 surgical and medical procedures including: PTCA Stenting, CABG bypass, valve replacement, knee/hip replacement, cancer chemotherapy/radiotherapy, neonatal care, and polytrauma. Beneficiaries must present Digital Aarogyasri Card, BPL Ration Card, or Aadhaar. 104 and 108 emergency transport covered free.

chunks.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY National Health Protection Scheme
chunks.condition: Chronic Kidney Disease, Hemodialysis, Multi-Organ Care
chunks.scheme_ref: National Health Authority (NHA)
chunks.content: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides health coverage of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families. Covers 1,949 treatment procedures. Key highlights: 1. Free maintenance hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis across all empaneled public & private dialysis centers. 2. Pre-hospitalization expenses (3 days) and post-hospitalization medications (15 days) included. 3. Zero copayment or deposit required at hospital admission counter.

chunks.condition: Generic Medicines, Chronic Diabetes, Hypertension, Antibiotics

chunks.content: Jan Aushadhi Kendras provide certified WHO-GMP quality generic medicines at 50% to 90% cheaper prices than branded equivalents: 1. Paracetamol 650mg (10 tabs): ₹12.50 (vs ₹34 branded). 2. Pantoprazole 40mg: ₹18.00 (vs ₹95 branded). 3. Metformin 500mg SR: ₹9.00 (vs ₹42 branded). 4. Telmisartan 40mg: ₹14.00 (vs ₹78 branded). 5. Cetirizine 10mg: ₹7.50 (vs ₹45 branded). All products meet Indian Pharmacopoeia standards.

chunks.title: Clinical Triage & Emergency Red Flag Decision Matrix
chunks.condition: Chest Pain, Acute Myocardial Infarction, Stroke, Unconsciousness
chunks.scheme_ref: Emergency Management & Research Institute (EMRI 108)
chunks.content: Emergency Triage Protocols: 1. Crushing chest pain radiating to left arm/jaw, diaphoresis: Suspect STEMI. Keep patient resting upright, administer Dispirin 300mg chewable immediately if no contraindications, dispatch 108 ambulance with ALS defibrillator. 2. FAST Stroke Assessment (Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call 108). Golden hour window is 4.5 hours for IV thrombolysis. 3. CPR Protocol: 30 hard and fast chest compressions (100-120 bpm) followed by 2 rescue breaths.
